style: Same dark-gold editorial system as sibling pieces in this video (pricing-tiers-reveal / revenue-math-reveal / demand-reputation-flywheel): near-black radial bg, League Gothic display caps + tabular-nums numerals, Montserrat labels, gold accent glow. Restrained, confident, no gimmicks — full-frame alpha-overlay replacement for a talking-head shot, not a corner bug. Complementary framing (SEO + ADS as one system), never 'ads bad / SEO good'.

customize.note: Attempted `npx hyperframes@0.7.68 catalog --tag=chart --json` — the pinned CLI's registry fetch timed out on essentially every item in this environment (network-degraded), so live catalog ranking couldn't be evaluated directly. Consistent with this same video's own precedent (revenue-math-reveal, demand-reputation-flywheel both searched the catalog and hand-authored anyway to preserve exact brand match — the registry's data-chart/bar-chart-race blocks bake in their own generic styling and would break the established CSS custom-property system), hand-authored here too, reusing this project's OWN proven local primitives verbatim: :root palette tokens, #bg-fill radial reveal, .scene/.clip padding contract, stat-glow/card-glow radial halo, the tier-track + tier-track-fill vertical-bar-growth chassis from pricing-tiers-reveal (rotated to vertical columns), and the divide-tick sequential-light-up pattern from revenue-math-reveal (reused for SEO's compounding-tick growth) rather than reinventing an equivalent.

data.growth: gradual — linear tick-by-tick fill from 0 to full across ~4.0s (0.9s-4.9s), reads as compounding/steady
near-instant — snaps 0 to full in 0.35s (0.9s-1.25s) with a flash + glow pulse + landing shake, reads as immediate

scenes.emotion: calm open — establishes the two-column comparison stage, complementary not adversarial (a plus, not a vs)
scenes.motion: bg-fill fade_in, eyebrow slide_top+fade_in, two empty vertical track outlines fade_in (dim, both visibly present from the start so neither reads as 'already ahead'), SEO/ADS column labels fade_in

scenes.emotion: sudden, punchy — ads turns on instantly
scenes.motion: ads-track-fill scaleY 0->1 in 0.35s ease power3.out (near-vertical snap, not eased-in like SEO) + glow-flash pulse on the ADS column + brief landing shake on the fill top edge; ADS caption slide_bottom+fade_in right after the snap lands

scenes.emotion: steady, building, durable — the slow-and-sure counterpoint running the whole time the ADS side already sits finished
scenes.motion: seo-track-fill grows in 8 discrete tick-segments (reused divide-tick sequential scaleY pattern) staggered evenly across 0.9s-4.9s, each tick landing with a small back.out pop (never a smooth continuous ramp — the discreteness IS the 'built step by step, compounding' read); SEO caption slide_bottom+fade_in once the climb is clearly reading as gradual (~4.5s)

scenes.emotion: resolved, confident — the two speeds land on the same result, together; freeze-hold for a clean cut back to host
scenes.motion: a horizontal glow-bridge bar wipes in beneath both full columns (bar-wipe pattern, reused from pricing-tiers-reveal), joining them visually; closing caption fade_in+slide_bottom directly beneath the bridge at ~5.5s; hold to 7.0s

columns.layout: two vertical track columns, mirrored, centered as a pair with a shared vertical center divider gap; SEO on the left, ADS on the right — same chassis on both sides so neither visually dominates

track.position: center ~y=540 (vertically centered in the stage, clear of top eyebrow and bottom closing caption)
track.track_bg: rgba(245,241,230,0.12), rounded, same visual weight as pricing-tiers-reveal .tier-track
track.fill: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-bright) 0%, var(--accent) 100%), grows bottom-to-top (transform-origin: bottom center)

columns.divider: thin vertical rule + small '+' glyph at the shared centerline between the two columns, present from t=0 — establishes 'together' before either bar moves
columns.collision_check: columns span x: 590-730 (SEO) and 1190-1330 (ADS), both track height 620 centered at y=540 (y: 230-850); top eyebrow row at y~150 (clear above track top 230); bottom captions at y~910 (clear below track bottom 850); closing bridge+caption at y~950-1010, well inside the 1080 frame and the >=80px title-safe margin
